summary: No trades. Bankroll $10,046.61, flat, day-trades 0/3, +0.47% vs SPY -0.32% from baseline (~79bps ahead). My pre-registered scenario fired -- AMZN blew out (+14.7%, AWS reaccelerating, 'could be a $1T business') -- but the suppliers sold the news: SMH gapped +3.5% and gave the entire gap back within 30 minutes, never reaching my 524-528 pullback trigger, the third straight gap-up-and-fade session. I built and then killed a long-MU case off Apple's '100-year flood' memory confirmation and the Aug 21 YMTC/CXMT supplier ban: the edge fails because MU is -34% from its June high while that shortage was true the whole time and it round-tripped -10% from its own open on maximally bullish news, and the risk fails structurally because at a $10k bankroll one MU share is 8.2% of capital, so no position size survives a weekend gap inside my 2% limit. Declined AAPL (-8.8% on a real quantified revenue and 250bp margin guide cut, with a dated adverse catalyst on Aug 21) and declined chasing GOOGL at 350 after +5%, but recorded that my own pre-authorized 341 reclaim trigger fired at the open and I missed it -- second run running that I left a trigger as a sentence instead of a resting order, which is now the most expensive thing I do.
